summary: 13 m kerb outside a shop, signed no stopping and next to a driveway.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time sign on the stretch
Shopfront on the kerb, homes beyond
Only 13 m, shorter than a van

drivers.seclusion: Retail building touches the kerb at 5 m; detached home 11 m away; apartments 28 m opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 13 m long and cut by a driveway; narrow lane with no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Swann Road through traffic both ways; junction nearby.
drivers.convention: Signs: No Stopping Any Time, 1P parallel Mon-Fri 9-5:30, no stopping 7-9am. Not an overnight spot.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign 1.4 m from kerb line
sun_shade: A tree shades the south side at the end; otherwise open.
